deliverables: 12 months of operations and maintenance for Circle USDCx, LayerZero, Pyth Price Feeds, and Dune Analytics integrations
Fireblocks native Cardano integration including ADA and Cardano Native Token support and foundations for staking and governance delegation workflows
Ring-fenced enhancement and tooling reserve for monitoring, reconciliation, observability, operational tooling, SDKs, and reference implementations
Legal, audit, contract administration, oversight, reporting, and contingency activities
request.recipient: Intersect, acting as Administrator under the Treasury Reserve Smart Contract Framework
request.what: Withdrawal from the Cardano Treasury for Cardano Critical Integrations V2, covering Year 2 contracted costs, a 12-month enhancement and maintenance program for CCI V1 integrations, and a new native Fireblocks integration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests ₳23,000,000, described as USD 5,750,000 at $0.25 per ADA, from the Cardano Treasury.
Funds will be administered by Intersect under the Treasury Reserve Smart Contract Framework, with drawdowns after signed agreements and Statements of Work are submitted and verified.
The proposer discloses that the prospective recipient structure previously received ₳70,000,000 from the Cardano Treasury under the Cardano Critical Integrations Budget in the prior 24 months.
CCI V1 integrations listed as Circle USDCx, LayerZero, Pyth, and Dune either launched on mainnet or are in implementation, and CCI V2 is intended to sustain, optimize, and extend them.
The CCI V1 integrations require ongoing annual payments for licensing, services, or attestations to remain operational.
CCI V2 funds a full native Cardano integration into Fireblocks, including ADA and CNT custody and transfer and technical foundations for staking and governance delegation workflows.
The high-level budget allocates ₳20,700,000 to integration and maintenance costs, ₳1,150,000 to enhancement and tooling reserve, and ₳1,150,000 to legal, audit, and contract administration.
Vendor-level costs are not publicly disclosed because of confidentiality obligations with several integration partners.
Unused funds at the end of the 12-month period or under listed refund circumstances will be returned to the Cardano Treasury.
The proposal excludes new tier-1 integrations, application-layer dApp funding, liquidity programs, marketing, events, and broader application-layer tooling outside the V1 integration perimeter.

summary: The document requests ₳23,000,000 for a 12-month continuation and expansion of critical integrations administered by Intersect, with most funds allocated to integration and maintenance costs, but vendor-level cost detail is withheld and the deterministic assessment reports missing budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and community impact analyses.
